evidence.subprocess_environment: copy of parent environment plus Python/Go cache directories
evidence.temporary_directory_reproduction: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'rustc'
evidence.toolchain_available_outside_parent_path: rustc 1.85.1 and cargo 1.85.1 under an ephemeral toolchain root

root_cause: The parent Python process could not resolve rustc, cargo, or rustup. The frozen harness converted an unresolved {rustc} placeholder to the literal string rustc and deferred discovery until each compile command, so FileNotFoundError became an ordinary compile failure after provider calls.
